title: Central Government override
description: The Central Government can prescribe a different value for the jurisdiction of the State Commission

content.general_rule: The State Commission has jurisdiction over complaints where the value of goods or services exceeds one crore but does not exceed ten crore rupees
content.exception: The Central Government can prescribe a different value
conditions: The Central Government deems it necessary

aliases: calling for records and passing orders
